- Fixed: the music player's media card (the phone's media notification) no longer appears out of nowhere when nothing is playing. A widget, tile or the Bluetooth check that loads the last queue (paused) used to pop it up; the card now shows only after something was really played.
- Fixed: a headset plugged in at zero volume no longer starts the old song later, on any volume press. The wait ends after a minute, and the song never starts over another player (YTXTube, a video, a call).
- YTXTube picture-in-picture: its Next button only moves among videos and never opens a song of the music queue.
- Files home: the "Received files" shortcut is gone (Pulse/Share is still a folder in the list).
- Convert: PowerPoint (.pptx) can be converted to PDF (one page per slide, real text and pictures), and spreadsheets (.xlsx) to PDF too. Convert files is also in Office tools, next to Scan document and PDF tools; the tools are two to a row with an icon, a name and a description, and the choices of the converter (PNG, JPG, PDF, M4A …) are tiles with an icon and a description instead of bare chips.
- YTXTube picture-in-picture: the headphones button plays the sound on in the background and no longer leaves audio-only on: back in the app the video shows and plays again (audio-only that was on before stays on).
- No more badges on the app icons for ongoing notifications (weather, YTXTube and video playback cards, Galaxy Buds): their channels are made without a badge. Pulse has many launcher icons and each wore the dot. Their notification channels were re-created, so a setting changed for them in the phone's notification settings starts from the default.
- Download manager: a link of the Stremio app's own local server (http://127.0.0.1:11470/<infohash>/<file>) is downloaded as the torrent itself (turned into a magnet link with the file's number), so Stremio does not need to be running. The idea of reading the hash out of such a link is that of Magnet Bridge (github.com/leffmarques/MagnetBridge); the code is written afresh.
- Series and movies: streams shared by 70 people or more come first, the size window is now from a quarter to twice the size wanted (it was 1.9x), and from YTXTube the page opens in the AMOLED black look (it showed the Windows look with the app's side rail over it).
- Keyboard: five letters or more of a file's name offer that file at the right of the bar (Download, Pictures, DCIM, Documents, Movies, Music); a tap sends it in a field that takes files and takes the typed letters away. Switch: Files in the bar (on).
- Keyboard clipboard: a picture whose original was deleted elsewhere (the gallery, Files) leaves the clipboard too; pinned ones stay. The keyboard only ever deletes its own copies in its clips folder, never the picture they were copied from.
- Download manager: deleting a download (one, or several chosen) asks first, with "Delete from the device" ticked by default (untick it to remove only from the list; it starts unticked when "delete only from list" is on in the settings). The folder a download sat in goes too when nothing is left in it (the downloads folder itself never).
- Series and movies: the downloaded file keeps its torrent's own file name (it was renamed to "Show S05E01"), so subtitle search and the player can find the release by it.
- App manager: the Debloat button stays on one line, and the filter summary is short (the order shows as "As" / "Ds") and cut off with dots when long, so the row is not two lines high.
- Keyboard speed: the corrections of a word's beginnings (the stems of a Turkish word, asked for again by every key) are kept for a few seconds instead of being worked out again from the whole word list each time, and the full correction pass waits a little longer for a pause in the typing (55 ms, it was 20), so fast typing does not queue heavy work behind every letter.
- YTXTube > Series and movies now opens inside YTXTube's own task: Back returns to YTXTube (it went to the phone's home screen), and the recent apps show YTXTube instead of a separate Pulse window.
- Keyboard in a terminal (Termux and the like): the bar no longer shows "Merhaba / Ben / Evet": it offers the commands (ls, cd, git, pkg, adb, cargo …) and the words typed there before, from their first letters, and a tap takes the place of the letters typed so far and adds a space. Nothing is mended or capitalised in a terminal, as before. The words are kept in memory only (a terminal sees passwords typed at prompts) and long mixed strings that look like keys are left out.
